title: [UE-0.7] Measure the palette
body:
### MVP item (number from docs/jam-brief.md), Day 0, or Stretch: <name>

Day 0

### GDD ref (section + short quote; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### GDD revision (the one in docs/gdd/CURRENT, e.g. 1.3)

1.3

### Features (IDs from docs/feature-manifest.json; add "Hook only" for an interface + default flag with no behavior, OPEN/PROPOSED only; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Player outcome (the player sees X, does Y, can tell why; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Owner role

Art Director

### Reviewer role (must differ from owner)

Technical Director

### Human who runs and merges this

Rick

### Inputs and outputs (exact paths)

Inputs: the files the Done-when names. Outputs: `pipeline/art/style.json`, `pipeline/art/reference/**`

### Context (what the code or asset next to Outputs does today, with file:line)

new files only

### File lane, do-not-touch paths, binary files to lock

Lane: `pipeline/art/style.json`, `pipeline/art/reference/**`
Do not touch: Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/**
Locks: none

### Out of scope (behaviors not to build; the reviewer rejects them)

anything outside the lane

### After (cards that must merge first: #<n> or UE-<n>, comma separated; "none")

none

### Used by (BPs, maps, widgets or components that read what this card changes; follow-up card IDs)

UE-0.10b

### Needs (build | tests | editor MCP | Windows packaging machine)

build, tests, Windows packaging machine

### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] The Art Director agent measures the key art (`art_check.py --measure-palette`) and writes the `style.json` values as the card's gate patch, measurements pasted (no art sign-off: the art gate is automated; `style.json` stays a guardrail file)
- [ ] Kickoff applies it itself through the tool checks (`python3 tools/git_gate.py apply UE-0.7 --auto`: every path in the card's lane, no guardrail enforcer changed, no guardrail file loosened; the PR has a `GATE EDIT: by=kickoff` line naming the patched paths)
- [ ] `python3 tools/art_check.py --references` exits 0: every required picture in `pipeline/art/references.json` is present (pasted)
- [ ] `git lfs ls-files` lists `pipeline/art/reference/target-keyart.png`
- [ ] `art_check.py --extract` output pasted; palette replaced with measured values and `palette_status: measured`
- [ ] `paper_texture_min` set to half the reference's measured `paper_texture` (about 0.38), so a near-flat frame fails
- [ ] `python3 -m unittest tests.test_art_check` prints OK with 0 skipped (ReferenceCalibrationTests ran)
- [ ] The key art still passes with the measured palette: `python3 tools/art_ref_check.py --card 0.10 --scene pipeline/art/reference/target-keyart.png` prints PASS (pasted)

### Budget and cut tier

60 min agent + 15 min human, MVP

### Unknowns (Decision needed / Why it matters / Proposed test / Choice; "none" if none)

none
